prompt: 我想给 miniClaw 加一个工具，能查询数据库。需要传入 SQL 查询语句，还可以选择性地指定数据库名称

assertions.text: Tool name follows module.function format (lowercase module, camelCase function)
Executor signature is (params: Record<string, unknown>): string
Params are type-cast inside executor with 'params as { ... }'
Required params are listed in required array and exist in properties
Optional param (database) has default value in executor
Variable name follows PascalCase module+Function concatenation
